Premier W. L. Mackenzie King announced in the House of Commons yesterday that Canada is negotiating with the United States for a treaty to suppress smuggling. He said the object of the treaty was not only to stop liquor traffic, but was designed to prevent smuggling of all kinds of merchandise both ways across the border.
